column1: # v271 remote attack layout (client reader 0x145699030), measured per skill with all-zero fields.
# shootPassive <skill>: REMOTE_SHOOT_ATTACK carries the passive hyper slv (+ id when > 0) after the skill id.
# extra <skill> <bytes>: the skill-specific block after the hit list is this many bytes (sent as zeros).
# extra 16: the skill type 7 branch reads two 8-byte values.
# repeatIndex <skill>: GMS counts the packets of one cast in the int after the summoned id.
